title: Horrible irritating fragrance
review: The scent is horrible - cheap smelling chemical. Usually but the Toleriane scent-free, but thought I'd try this. My eyes and nasal passages reacted even though I didn't use on my face - aerosolized in the shower. Even my lips and hands became irritated, sore and peeled. Taking quite a few days to settle after stopping use...shame that this product couldn't be scent free. Back to Toleriane.

title: Still stinky after :(
review: It not provide adequate skin cleaning such as removing body odour. Such a shame as it’s not cheap. It has a subtle scent and nice texture. BUT it does not effectively clean the body.

title: Delicato e idratante
review: Uso da tempo il Lipikar Doccia Gel di La Roche-Posay e lo trovo ottimo soprattutto per pelli secche, sensibili o facilmente irritabili. È un detergente molto delicato, non aggressivo, con una profumazione leggera e pulita, adatto anche all’uso quotidiano. Lascia la pelle morbida e idratata già dopo la doccia, senza quella sensazione di pelle che tira. Ideale in caso di secchezza, prurito o pelle stressata, anche nei periodi invernali o dopo sport/piscina. La versione eco-refill è davvero comoda: permette di riempire i flaconi con dosatore che si hanno già, riducendo sprechi e plastica. Inoltre dura a lungo ed è pratica anche per famiglie. Nel complesso: detergente delicato e lenitivo adatto a pelli sensibili e secche profumazione leggera ottimo per uso quotidiano formato refill pratico ed ecologico Consigliato a chi cerca un bagnodoccia affidabile, dermatologico e non aggressivo.

title: Great for dry skin
review: I’m already itchy from the change in temperature and this is the only wash I can use during the cold months that doesn’t dry out my skin. It’s soothing and has a slight scent that’s pleasant.

title: Refill option finally available
review: Finally a refill available for the best gel ever! Thank you :):)

title: Lovely Shower Gel From A Quality Brand
review: This refill pouch is intended to refill a bottle, but if used with care can be used straight from the pouch. It is quite a runny consistency and has a pleasant but not overly strong scent. It lathers well and leaves my sensitive skin feeling clean and hydrated without any reaction. Worth the money for those with sensitive skin.

title: Great quality shower gel
review: This is a great quality shower gel that works well with a scrubbing exfoliator to leave skin smooth and well hydrated. It has a very subtle almost clinical smell which is pleasant. It is very thin in consistency and really needs to be decanted into a pump bottle as is intended (this is a refill). I tried using it in a foaming pump bottle but this doesn’t work as the gel doesn’t really lather at all, so I’ve switched it into a normal pump top bottle and this works well.

title: Lovely scent and good for sensitive skin
review: This shower gel works wonderfully on my sensitive skin. It has a nice subtle scent to it without being too fragranced and overpowering. It lathers up well and my skin feels clean and fresh after use.

title: work well
review: This La Roche Posay gel is very soothing and the texture is smooth and easy to apply. I use this a few times every week.

title: Good Shower Gel
review: Pros: Easy to decant into a pump bottle or refill bottle Nice lather and soft, clean scent suitable for the whole family Leaves skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed Suitable for sensitive skin Neutral pH for the skin Cons: Expensive Runny consistency can pour out of the bottle quickly if not decanted Overall, I'm very satisfied with this shower gel. It's a great option for sensitive skin, and the scent is lovely. While it's a bit pricey, the product quality and performance make it worth considering. I'd definitely repurchase it.

title: Lovely shower gel - good for sensitive skin
review: The shower gel smells lovely and my sensitive skin approves of it.

title: Great product
review: I am a big fan of La Roche products and this shower gel certainly did not disappoint. It comes in a handy packet with screw top, making it easy to pour. The shower gel lathers up well and leaves the skin feeling clean and fresh. The gel has a subtle, yet nice smell. I have very sensitive skin and this does not irritate me. I am very happy with this product and I am very happy to recommend

title: Refill pouch
review: This la Roche posay shower gel comes in a handy refill pouch- I really like this as it helps save on plastic waste and makes the product a little cheaper. This shower gel is really gentle on sensitive skin and nourishing too. It doesn’t have much of a scent to it but feels nice and cleansing to the skin. This is an excellent brand with high quality products.

title: Same scent, consistency and results as original gel
review: Wash: Deep cleaning, not too drying, still need moisturiser after. Fine on face, or delicates, removes body odour, apply undiluted to wet skin, massage for 1 min. lathers & deep cleans best with an exfoliating glove. Not too scented. Refil review: Expires 12 months after opening, but it will be gone by then. Once empty easy to cut open, a get last bits out. Purchased original bottle in store.. Only negative is I wish the bag had a hook loop, needs a spare longer nozzle attachment as you have to wait for air bubbles to gloop down bottle opening or it backs up and spills over. Recyclable less waste. Check the sellers, I keep forgetting to do this when buying toiletries on here. There’s multiple for the same listing, for french brands I go French or official brand amazon page

title: A premium product
review: La Roche-Posay Lipikar Gel Lavant Refill 400ml This is a brand I have often used as part of my beauty routine and this is another good quality, premium product. I have skin that is prone to dryness and itchiness and there Lipkar Baum is my number one go to skin product, so I was really pleased to be able to try this shower gel. if foams nicely and leaves my skin feeling lovely. It is gentle enough to use as a face wash too, so no need for a separate product. It is fragrance free, which I take it to mean that no fragrances have been added as it does have a very subtle clean smell. Buying a refill makes this a good value way or purchasing the product. It is an effective, quality product that I will buy again.

title: Pleasant to use
review: I’ve only had limited chances previously to try products from La Roche Posay but generally been impressed so was hoping that would carry through with this shower gel. The shower gel comes in a reasonable sized pouch that is intended to refill a larger bottle but can also be used with care on its own. The thin consistency of the liquid makes it easy to apply and does a good job of cleaning building up a decent and well attached lather. The scent is pleasant and long lasting. Overall then I look forward to taking a few more showers with this gel.

title: A little goes a long way
review: This shower gel has a nice and thick consistency and a little goes a long way. It lathers up well and although this product is unscented it does have a really fresh and lovely aroma. The refill pouch works well and is easy to open. I would’ve preferred the formulation to be sulfate free but found that it didn’t dry out my skin.

title: Great product
review: I love this shower gel, it leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and hydrated without any tight, dry sensation afterward. The scent is subtle yet lovely, adding a gentle freshness to my routine. A little goes a long way, making it super efficient, and for one person, this 400ml refill easily lasts a full month. Highly recommend refill for anyone seeking a gentle, effective cleanser that pampers sensitive skin!

title: Lovely fragrance just wish they made an SLS free version
review: I love the fragrance of this shower gel, it’s a well balance floral smell that reminds me of Honeysuckle. The added glycerol, oils and shea butter generally leave my skin lovely and soft. However, with regular daily use personally I find like most SLS formulas it can start to irritate my skin.

title: Great for sensitive skin
review: Lovely and gentle bodywash. I've been dealing with some sensitive skin recently and this being pH balanced has been great at helping with that. Would highly recommend this to anyone dealing with irritated skin and not having much success with other brands.

title: Amazing but pricey!
review: Amazing shower gel - one of the best I've used but the price is eye-watering. If you want a treat then this will do! Really nice for the skin.

title: Fab!
review: I really like refill products like this as they help the environment but also just make sense too. This one is very practical, the shower gel is nice and loose so it's easy to decant it, and the nozzle is also good as it can go into the neck of the bottle i was decanting it into..it made pouring it into the bottle really easy, with no shower gel being spilt. The shower gel itself is fab. A little bit goes a long way as it really lathers up well. It smells lovely and left my skin feeling really smooth and clean. I am very impressed with it. I do think it's worth the price tag!

title: Quality Shower Gel
review: Really nice shower gel, it smells the same as the face scrub I use (which might be unscented to be fair). Lathers very well (I do have softened water though) and my skin feels clean. No more than normal shower gel but the sensitive nature gives me reassurance than it won't irritate my skin and although it is expensive, La Roche Posay is one of the better brands in terms of skin care that I would be more willing to trust.

title: Gentle and really good for sensitive skin
review: Bought this refill for the whole family as we all have pretty sensitive skin. It cleans well without drying out, which is a big win in my book. The gel feels light and fresh, and a little goes a long way. Love that it’s a refill, so less plastic waste which makes me feel a bit better about the planet. Perfect for everyday use and lasts ages. Would definitely buy again when this one runs out.

title: Nice results
review: A gentle floral scent . Not a lot of lather but cleans just as well. The consistency is slightly thick and transparent. A reseable cap so you can either use direct from the pouch or re fill an existing bottle Good value for a quality product because it works out cheaper than buying the bottle and you get a lot in this pouch so it lasts a long while

title: Lovely gel, but difficult to remove from pouch
review: This is a rich shower gel that readily foams to gently cleanse your skin and envelope you in a pleasing fragrance. It is supplied in a soft pouch with such a tightly fitting cap that it takes some work to remove; it then needs to be decanted into a bottle for use, which results in a disappointing amount of waste.

title: From baby to grown up
review: Super gentle and no fragrance overload, cleans well feels soft, no tightness after, like that I can refill instead of rebuying a new bottle every time!

title: It's a 400ml La Roche Posay gel wash pouch...
review: This is exactly as expected; a La Roche-Posay gel wash refill with a slim easy pour cap so you can fill up a large dispenser bottle or smaller travel bottles easily. I’ve uploaded a clip showing the full ingredients list printed on my pouch.

title: Simple, gentle, and a great refill option.
review: I’ve been using La Roche-Posay for years and it’s definitely one of my go-to brands for sensitive skin. This Lipikar Gel Lavant shower gel is really gentle and versatile—I use it on my face, body, and even my scalp sometimes. Most of the time, though, I stick to using it on my face as part of my double cleansing in the evening. It doesn’t lather much or get foamy like typical shower gels, but I think that’s a good thing—it feels like it’s made with fewer ingredients and no harsh chemicals. I used to have dry patches on my arms, and after using this along with a moisturiser from the same brand, those patches have pretty much disappeared. The refill pouch is a nice bonus—it's more affordable than buying a new bottle and better for the environment, so it feels like a win all around.

title: Smells really nice and leaves skin soft and clean
review: 400ml shower gel refill, which is really easy to decant into the same product pump bottle or your own refill bottle version. The consistency of this shower gel is quite a runny clear gel, so does pour out of the bottle quite quickly if you are not decanting it from a pump bottle. The shower gel has a really nice lather to it and contains a really nice soft clean type of scent to it, which is suitable for all the family to use. The scent does linger on your skin after you have used it. Overall, this shower gel is on the expensive side however, it is suitable for sensitive skin and it did leave my skin feeling really clean, soft and refreshed after using it. I really liked using it and should last me a few weeks before I need to replace it. I would happily repurchase again.

title: Utterly amazing smell.
review: This is a refill pack for a La Roche-Posay shower gel. I’ll be honest - I don’t have the original bottle to refill this into, so it’s currently in a silicone travel bottle so I could use it immediately. And I’m glad I am. It’s a really lovely shower gel, as you’d expect from such a well known and respected brand. It’s completely clear and quite thick and boy does it foam up! You only need a touch for a massive foam. It cleans well and leaves the most amazing smell that is like an high end perfume or aftershave. Glorious. And good for the environment with less bottles and simple refill pouches :)

title: Lovely quality
review: The gel has a creamy texture that gently foams without over-drying, and it leaves my skin feeling clean yet comfortably hydrated. I appreciate how it’s gentle enough for daily use even on sensitive areas with no tightness or irritation afterward. Plus, the larger refill size is more eco-friendly and economical.
